verdict.rationale: The only residency path in the evidence is self-hosting, which the docs say gives you full control over your environment and infrastructure, so you can decide where data lives by running the platform yourself. Nothing shows a region or data-residency choice on the managed Trigger.dev Cloud, so this is a heavyweight workaround rather than a residency setting. Missing for 10: region selection on the managed cloud, documented data-residency guarantees (e.g. EU hosting), and independent corroboration of residency control.
